title: Communicate Changes with Props and Emits
short_description: Practice how a component receives a value through props and requests changes with emits.
description: In this challenge, you will complete a quantity picker that works like a controlled component.
The child component must render the value received through props and emit update:modelValue when the user wants to change the quantity. You will then connect that value to the parent component state.
instructions: Declare the update:modelValue event with defineEmits.
Make decrease emit modelValue - 1 only if the current value is greater than min.
Make increase emit modelValue + 1 only if the current value is lower than max.
Do not change props.modelValue directly inside the child component.
In App.vue, connect quantity to QuantityStepper using v-model.

hints.title: Declare the emit
hints.body: You can declare the event with `const emit = defineEmits(["update:modelValue"])`

hints.title: Emit the new value
hints.body: The child does not store the final quantity. It only requests the change with `emit("update:modelValue", nextValue)`

hints.title: Respect the limits
hints.body: Before emitting, compare `props.modelValue` with `props.min` or `props.max` to avoid leaving the allowed range.

hints.title: Connect the parent component
hints.body: In `App.vue`, `v-model` passes `quantity` as `modelValue` and listens for `update:modelValue` with a single directive.
